svg.title: Kabonk! - 3. Micro: Playing Screen (one player's view, every state)

g.text: Kabonk! - 3. Micro: Playing Screen (one player's view, every state)
players in a circle around the bomb,
bomb ticking, arrow points at you,
type a letter / others see it live;
submit invalid word / error + word shakes
(missing the letters, not a real word,
current player enters a valid word
type message + Enter / sent to room;
Every exit goes back to the Main Menu.
A player who leaves mid-game and comes back
